en.name: Coconut cream, canned
en.summary: Canned coconut cream keeps 2–5 years from purchase in the cupboard, unopened. Once opened it is a perishable low-acid food: 4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 3 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: An unopened can keeps 2–5 years from purchase in a cool, dry, dark cupboard. That long life belongs to the commercial heat processing and the sealed can, not to the coconut — coconut cream is a low-acid, fat-and-protein emulsion, and outside the can it is one of the more perishable things in this category. Store cans off a damp floor and away from the hob, and discard without tasting any can that is bulging, leaking or hisses when opened. Separation of the thick cream from the thin liquid inside an unopened can is normal, not a fault.
en.fridge: Once opened, transfer the contents to a clean covered container and refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for 4 days. Four days is short, and it is short for a reason: a moist, low-acid emulsion is an excellent growth medium once the sterile seal is gone. It will thicken and separate in the cold, which is normal — stir or warm it gently and it comes back. Never leave the leftovers standing in the open can.
en.freezer: It keeps 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze the leftovers straight after opening rather than at the end of the fridge window, in small portions or an ice cube tray so you can take out what a curry needs. Be prepared for it to look wrong on thawing — the emulsion splits and the fat separates into grains — but it stirs or blends back together once heated, and it is perfectly good in cooking. It will not whip after freezing.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, then warm it gently and stir or blend to bring the emulsion back. You can also drop frozen cubes straight into a hot curry or soup. Never thaw on the counter.
spoilage: A sour, sharp or fermented smell rather than a sweet coconut one.
A bulging or leaking can, or one that hisses or spurts when opened.
Pink, grey or yellow discolouration, or any mould at the surface.
Cream that has gone slimy or stringy rather than thick and separated.
tips: Decant leftovers into a covered container; never store the open can.
Freeze the surplus in an ice cube tray on the day you open the can.
Chill an unopened can to scoop the thick cream off the top cleanly.
Expect separation in the fridge and after freezing — it is normal and reverses with heat.

faq.q: How long does coconut cream last once opened?
faq.a: 4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in a covered container, or 3 months frozen at −18 °C (0 °F).
Yes, 3 months at −18 °C. It splits on thawing but comes back together when heated and stirred — use it in cooking rather than for whipping.

faq.q: Is it normal for coconut cream to separate?
faq.a: Yes. It separates in the can, in the fridge and after freezing. Warming and stirring brings it back.

zh.name: 椰漿罐頭
zh.summary: 未開封的椰漿罐頭從購買日起算放櫥櫃可放 2～5 年。開封後它就是易腐的低酸性食品：4 °C 以下冷藏 4 天，或 −18 °C 冷凍 3 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐頭放陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算 2～5 年。這麼長的期限屬於商業加熱殺菌和密封罐體，不屬於椰子本身——椰漿是低酸性的油脂與蛋白質乳化物，一離開罐子，它是這一類裡比較容易壞的東西之一。罐頭不要放在潮濕地面，也要遠離爐台；膨脹、滲漏或打開時有洩氣聲的，請直接丟棄、不要試吃。未開封的罐頭裡濃厚的椰漿與稀薄的汁液分層是正常現象，不是瑕疵。
zh.fridge: 開封後把內容物移到乾淨的加蓋容器，放 4 °C 以下 4 天。四天很短，而且短得有理由：一份含水的低酸性乳化物，在失去無菌密封之後就是很好的培養基。它在低溫下會變稠、分層，這是正常的——攪一攪或稍微加熱就會回來。剩下的絕對不要留在開過的罐子裡。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下可放 3 個月。請在開罐後就立刻把剩下的冷凍，不要拖到冷藏期的最後一天；分成小份或倒進製冰盒，煮一道咖哩要多少拿多少。要有心理準備：解凍後它看起來會很不對勁——乳化崩解、油脂結成顆粒——但加熱後攪拌或用調理棒打一下就回來了，入菜完全沒問題。不過冷凍過就打不發了。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，再小火加熱並攪拌或打勻，讓乳化回復。也可以把冷凍的方塊直接丟進熱咖哩或湯裡。不要放室溫退冰。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸、刺鼻或有發酵味，而不是椰子的甜香。
罐身膨脹或滲漏，或打開時有洩氣聲、噴汁。
出現粉紅、灰色或泛黃，或表面長霉。
椰漿變得黏滑牽絲，而不是「濃稠但分層」。
tips: 剩料倒進加蓋容器；絕對不要整罐開著冰。
開罐當天就把多的倒進製冰盒冷凍。
先把未開封的罐頭冰過，上層濃厚的椰漿才好整塊挖起來。
冷藏和冷凍後會分層，這是正常的，加熱就會回來。

faq.q: 椰漿開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 加蓋容器放 4 °C 以下 4 天，或 −18 °C 冷凍 3 個月。
可以，−18 °C 下 3 個月。解凍後會分離，但加熱攪勻就會回來——適合入菜，不適合打發。
正常。它在罐子裡、在冰箱裡、冷凍之後都會分層，加熱攪拌就會恢復。
